bio.en: I am an undergraduate student in the Department of Computer Science and Information Engineering at National Taiwan University (NTU CSIE). My research interests include multimodal large language models, computer vision, diffusion models, and AI security.
bio.zh: 我是國立臺灣大學資訊工程學系的大學部學生，研究興趣包括多模態大型語言模型、電腦視覺、擴散模型與 AI 安全。
